description: Exact address can receive fresh externally-originated message through production route

rules.TRUE: QP nonce N observed in exact mailbox A within freshness bounds AND dns_configured AND email_route_configured are TRUE
rules.FALSE: only decisive bounded negative (e.g. authenticated terminal bounce if spec accepts that as falsifier)
rules.UNKNOWN: timeout without decisive negative, sender failure, probe failure, outage, ambiguity
critical: Need actual nonce round-trip, not just MX/routing verification
Probe must query exact mailbox, never global token search

evidence_requirements: QP generates cryptographically random nonce N
Independent sender sends N to exact A
Probe queries exact mailbox A, never global token search
Evidence binds A, N, sender, provider/raw message ID, timestamps and raw-message hash
